analysis:
The apps/api/src/graph/ directory is completely empty — all graph persistence and traversal services are greenfield. apps/api/src/codeintel/ does not exist — all AST/symbol and impact-analysis services are greenfield. The Prisma schema at apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma currently lacks GraphNode, GraphLink, EntityNode, EntityLink, and Symbol models; these must be added with a migration.

RagService.importGraphify() in apps/api/src/rag/rag.service.ts currently performs a destructive full re-import: it calls deleteAllBySourceType(projectId, 'code') then re-indexes every node into LanceDB. This O(n) behavior must be replaced by IncrementalGraphDiffService, which loads the stored graph from durable GraphNode/GraphLink tables, computes added/updated/removed deltas, and re-indexes only changed nodes.

RagController.importGraphify() in apps/api/src/rag/rag.controller.ts currently restricts access to ADMIN only. The spec expands this to admin, developer, or agent. KodaDomainWriter.importGraphify() in apps/api/src/koda-domain-writer/koda-domain-writer.service.ts consumes RagService.importGraphify() and expects the return shape { imported: number; cleared: number }. Changing this to DiffResult is a breaking interface change that will require updates in the writer service and its tests. Multiple test suites mock importGraphify returning { imported, cleared }: koda-domain-writer.service.spec.ts, koda-domain-writer.integration.spec.ts, graphify-kb-validation.integration.spec.ts, rag.service.spec.ts, and rag-project-id-validation.integration.spec.ts.

The Outbox system (OutboxService, OutboxFanOutRegistry, PrismaOutboxRepository) is already in place and extensible. New code_commit event handlers can be registered in the fan-out registry. VCS webhook handling (VcsWebhookController, VcsWebhookService) currently routes issues and pull_request events; push events are not handled and must be added. The GitHub provider does not implement fetchCommitFiles; the IVcsProvider interface must be extended.

EntityStore at apps/api/src/rag/entity-store.ts is Phase 2's in-memory index. Phase 4 must not use it for graph traversal or impact analysis; instead it introduces durable EntityNode/EntityLink tables. Prisma uses SQLite; arrays/objects must be stored as JSON-encoded strings and validated in repositories/services, following the existing pattern in MemoryItem and OutboxEvent.

The repository abstraction (AbstractPrismaRepository, TRANSACTION_MANAGER from @nathapp/nestjs-data) is established and should be used for new persistence. AppModule will need new modules registered.

Risks:
1. Breaking change to importGraphify return type — affects controller, domain writer, and ~5 test suites.
2. Circular dependency risk — VcsModule already imports RagModule. New graph/codeintel modules must not create cycles.
3. Performance regression — diff-and-apply must complete in <2s for 500+ nodes; the implementation must use batch operations and avoid N+1 queries.
4. Schema migration — adding 5 models with foreign keys to Project requires a Prisma migration and db:generate.
5. ts-morph dependency — AST indexing requires adding ts-morph to apps/api; parser failures must not abort the entire commit.

Migration path:
1. Add Prisma models and run migration.
2. Implement IncrementalGraphDiffService with GraphStoreService/repositories and update RagService.importGraphify() to delegate to it.
3. Update RagController.importGraphify() role check and return type.
4. Update KodaDomainWriter.importGraphify() and all affected tests to expect DiffResult.
5. Add fetchCommitFiles to VCS provider interface and GitHub implementation.
6. Implement AstIndexService, EntityGraphService, ImpactAnalysisService, CanonicalStateService.
7. Register new outbox handlers and extend VCS webhook for push events.
8. Add new controllers/modules to AppModule and regenerate openapi.json.

userStories.title: Incremental Graph Diff — Replace Full Re-Import
acceptanceCriteria: IncrementalGraphDiffService.diffAndApply() computes a diff and applies only the delta
Stored graph is loaded from GraphNode + GraphLink Prisma tables; not from LanceDB
When newNodes has 100 nodes and stored has 90, diffAndApply returns added=10 and removed=0
When a stored node is absent from newNodes, it is deleted from both GraphNode table and LanceDB by its graphify nodeId / RAG sourceId
When a node exists in both with unchanged content, it is skipped and no re-index occurs
diffAndApply is called by the existing importGraphify endpoint, replacing the current deleteAllBySourceType logic
DiffResult.indexed reflects only the number of nodes actually written to LanceDB
A diff-and-apply of 500 unchanged nodes + 10 added + 5 removed completes in under 2 seconds
DiffResult includes durationMs for performance monitoring
Only actors with role admin, developer, or agent can call importGraphify (enforced at controller layer)
suggestedCriteria: diffAndApply returns durationMs greater than 0 even when no changes are detected
When newNodes is empty and stored graph has nodes, all stored nodes are marked removed and deleted from both tables and LanceDB
Concurrent calls to diffAndApply for the same projectId do not corrupt the stored graph or LanceDB state

routing.reasoning: Multi-module service with new repositories, diff algorithm, LanceDB integration, and a security-critical role check expansion at the controller layer.

userStories.title: AST/Symbol Index Pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: AstIndexService.indexCommit() parses source files and stores symbol metadata in the Symbol Prisma table
Symbol.symbolId uses the convention {repoId}:{filePath}::{SymbolName} and is globally unique within a project
getCallers(symbolId) returns all symbols that include this symbol in their JSON callers list
getCallees(symbolId) returns all symbols in this symbol's JSON callees list
When indexCommit is called with files=[{path: 'src/auth.ts', content: '...'}], only src/auth.ts is parsed and existing symbols for unchanged files are preserved
Symbol.signature captures parameter types and return type (e.g. (userId: string): Promise<User>)
Indexing is triggered by a code_commit outbox event fired by the VCS webhook handler
A commit with 20 files (avg 200 lines each) is indexed in under 30 seconds
Only actors with role admin or developer can call AstIndexService.indexCommit() directly; role is checked at controller layer
Parser failures for one file are recorded in SymbolIndexResult.fileErrors and do not prevent other files in the same commit from being indexed
The code_commit handler resolves changed file contents before calling indexCommit(); the webhook controller only enqueues commit metadata
suggestedCriteria: indexCommit with an empty files array returns symbolsIndexed=0 without error
getSymbol returns null when symbolId does not exist in the project
getCallers returns an empty array when no symbols reference the given symbolId

routing.reasoning: New ts-morph integration, symbol storage with JSON string arrays, outbox handler wiring, and security-critical direct-access role check.

userStories.title: Ticket/Entity Graph Builder
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Build and maintain a durable entity graph linking tickets, services, owners, and incidents using ticket events and graphify nodes.

**Motivation** — The code graph is isolated from operational context; there is no ticket/entity graph connecting code changes to operational impact.

**Approach** — Entity nodes and links are persisted in EntityNode and EntityLink Prisma tables. Do not depend on Phase 2's in-memory EntityStore for graph traversal or impact analysis.

Entity node types:
- ticket: extracted from TicketEvent
- service: extracted from graphify node type=code_module (file path = service boundary)
- owner: extracted from ticket assignedToUserId or assignedToAgentId
- incident: extracted from tickets with priority=critical or priority=high

Link creation:
- ticket -> service: inferred from gitRefFile, linked code files, graphified source_file, labels, or a future explicit serviceId
- ticket -> owner: from assignedToUserId or assignedToAgentId
- service -> service: from graphify links with relation='depends_on'
- incident -> ticket: from incident ticket linking events

**Scope** — In: EntityGraphService, EntityNode/EntityLink repositories, Prisma schema additions, outbox fan-out handlers for ticket_event and graphify_import. Out: AST parsing, impact score computation, VCS webhook.

**Interface**
```typescript
class EntityGraphService {
  constructor(private entityStore: EntityStore) {}

  async rebuildGraph(projectId: string): Promise<void>
  async onTicketEvent(event: TicketEvent): Promise<void>
  async onGraphifyImport(projectId: string, nodes: GraphifyNodeDto[]): Promise<void>
  async getRelatedEntities(projectId: string, entityId: string, depth?: number): Promise<EntityPath[]>
  async getIncidentImpact(projectId: string, incidentTicketId: string): Promise<ImpactAnalysis>
}

interface EntityPath {
  path: EntityRecord[];
  relation: string;
  depth: number;
}

interface ImpactAnalysis {
  incidentTicketId: string;
  affectedServices: EntityRecord[];
  affectedTickets: EntityRecord[];
  affectedCodeModules: EntityRecord[];
  rootCause?: string;
}
```

**Schema additions**
```prisma
model EntityNode {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  projectId   String
  entityId    String
  type        String
  label       String
  tags        String   @default("[]")
  sourceType  String?
  sourceId    String?
  metadata    String   @default("{}")
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  project       Project @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id])
  outgoingLinks EntityLink[] @relation("EntityLinkSource")
  incomingLinks EntityLink[] @relation("EntityLinkTarget")
  @@unique([projectId, entityId])
  @@index([projectId, type])
}

model EntityLink {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  projectId      String
  sourceEntityNodeId String
  targetEntityNodeId String
  relation       String
  confidence     Float    @default(0.8)
  sourceType     String?
  sourceId       String?
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  project      Project @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id])
  sourceEntity EntityNode @relation("EntityLinkSource", fields: [sourceEntityNodeId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  targetEntity EntityNode @relation("EntityLinkTarget", fields: [targetEntityNodeId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@unique([projectId, sourceEntityNodeId, targetEntityNodeId, relation])
  @@index([projectId, sourceEntityNodeId])
  @@index([projectId, targetEntityNodeId])
}
```
acceptanceCriteria: EntityGraphService.rebuildGraph(projectId) rebuilds all entity nodes and links for a project
Entity graph data is persisted in EntityNode and EntityLink tables, not only in Phase 2's in-memory EntityStore
onTicketEvent(status_changed) updates the entity node for that ticket if it exists
onGraphifyImport() extracts service entities from graphify nodes with type=code_module
The initial implementation does not require a Ticket.serviceId column; service linkage works from current Koda fields (gitRefFile, labels, linked code/module references)
getRelatedEntities(projectId, entityId, depth=2) returns all entities reachable within 2 hops
getIncidentImpact(projectId, incidentTicketId) returns all entities linked to the incident
Service entities extracted from graphify inherit tags from the graphify node (e.g. ['backend', 'auth'])
Entity graph is updated incrementally via outbox fan-out with no full rebuild on every event
A graph with 500 nodes and 2000 edges returns getRelatedEntities in under 50ms
suggestedCriteria: onTicketEvent for a ticket that does not exist in the EntityNode table creates the entity node instead of failing
rebuildGraph deletes stale EntityLink records that no longer have corresponding source or target entities
getIncidentImpact returns empty arrays when the incident ticket has no linked entities

routing.reasoning: Graph traversal algorithms, durable persistence with JSON string fields, outbox integration, and performance constraints — but no security-critical access control changes.

userStories.title: VCS Webhook Handler → code_commit Outbox Event
acceptanceCriteria: VcsWebhookController extends the existing project-scoped webhook surface at POST /projects/:slug/vcs-webhook to handle push/code-intel events
Webhook payload is validated: presence of repository identifier, ref, commits[], and sender identifier (sender.id, sender.login, or provider equivalent)
For each commit in the push, a code_commit outbox event is enqueued with { repoId, commitHash, ref, changedFiles }
AstIndexService.indexCommit() is called by the code_commit outbox handler, not synchronously by the webhook controller
If event enqueue fails, the webhook logs the failure and returns a non-2xx response so the provider can retry
GitHub webhook signature verification reuses the existing x-hub-signature-256 flow already used by Koda VCS webhooks; invalid signatures return 401
The webhook secret continues to come from the project's VCS connection record and is never hard-coded
Webhook handler is idempotent: pushing the same commitHash twice does not create duplicate outbox events (dedup by commitHash within a 5-minute window)
suggestedCriteria: Webhook payload with commits array containing entries without id or timestamp is rejected with 400
Dedup window of 5 minutes is enforced using createdAt of existing outbox events, not wall-clock time of webhook arrival
Push event to a project without a VCS connection returns 404

routing.reasoning: Standard webhook extension and outbox enqueue with existing signature verification; no new security-critical crypto code.

userStories.title: getChangeImpact API
acceptanceCriteria: GET /projects/:slug/codeintel/impact?repoId=X&commitHash=Y&changedFiles=file1,file2 returns a ChangeImpactResult
impactedSymbols contains symbols whose file matches any entry in changedFiles
impactedServices contains service entities linked to impacted symbols through matching Symbol.file to GraphNode.sourceFile or EntityNode.sourceId
impactedTickets contains tickets linked to any impactedServices
impactScore is a number 0-100 computed by the formula in the design section
When called with a ticketId, the result includes provenance source metadata pointing to that ticket
The endpoint returns in under 5 seconds for a commit touching up to 50 files
Only actors with role admin, developer, or agent can call this endpoint (role checked at controller layer)
suggestedCriteria: impactScore returns 0 when no symbols, services, or tickets are affected
impactScore clamps to 100 when the computed raw score exceeds 100
Query with a changedFiles entry that matches no symbols returns empty impactedSymbols

routing.reasoning: Cross-module integration endpoint with security-critical role checks and a composite scoring formula that requires careful verification.

userStories.title: CanonicalStateService Snapshot Read Layer
acceptanceCriteria: CanonicalStateService.getSnapshot(query) returns retrievedAt set to the server timestamp
When ticketIds are provided, tickets contains only tickets in the requested projectId
When timeWindow is provided, recentEvents contains only events in the window ordered by createdAt DESC
activeDecisions is populated from active MemoryItem rows with kind='DECISION'
A non-existent or unauthorized projectId throws the same KodaError/Nathapp exception style used by earlier memory endpoints
The service performs canonical Prisma reads only; it does not query LanceDB, BM25, entity graph, or other derived stores
suggestedCriteria: getSnapshot with an empty ticketIds array returns tickets as an empty array
getSnapshot called without timeWindow returns recentEvents as an empty array
activeDecisions excludes MemoryItem rows with status='superseded' or status='rejected'

routing.reasoning: Read-only service composing existing Prisma queries; no new persistence or security-critical changes.
